tool.name: TransitionListEvidenceFilter
tool.description: Filter transition-list precursors by quick raw-data evidence
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in_cond.in && #if $in_cond.in_select == "no" mkdir ${' '.join(["'in_cond.in/%s'" % (i) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} && ${' '.join(["cp '%s' 'in_cond.in/%s/%s.%s' && " % (f, i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} #else cp '$in_cond.in' 'in_cond.in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_cond.in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_cond.in.ext)' && #end if mkdir tr && cp '$tr' 'tr/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $tr.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($tr.ext)' && mkdir out && #if $swath_windows_file: mkdir swath_windows_file && cp '$swath_windows_file' 'swath_windows_file/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $swath_windows_file.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($swath_windows_file.ext)' && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in #if $in_cond.in_select == "no" ${' '.join(["'in_cond.in/%s/%s.%s'"%(i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} #else 'in_cond.in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_cond.in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_cond.in.ext)' #end if -tr 'tr/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $tr.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($tr.ext)' -out 'out/output.${out_type}' #if $swath_windows_file: -swath_windows_file 'swath_windows_file/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $swath_windows_file.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($swath_windows_file.ext)' #end if
## Postprocessing && mv 'out/output.${out_type}' '$out' #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.name: in_select
param.label: Run tool in batch mode for -in
param.option: Yes: process each dataset in an independent job

param.label: Input mzML/sqMass files
param.help: By default each file is treated as one run select mzml,mzxml,sqmass data sets(s)

param.label: Input mzML/sqMass files
param.help: By default each file is treated as one run select mzml,mzxml,sqmass data sets(s)

param.label: Input transition file ('TraML', 'tsv', 'pqp', or 'oswpq')
param.help: select pqp,tabular,traml data sets(s)

param.label: Output transition file type
param.help: Default: determined from file extension

validator.message: A value needs to be selected

param.label: Data is PASEF data
param.help: If omitted, the tool auto-detects ion mobility SWATH windows

param.label: Optional tab-separated file containing SWATH windows for extraction: lower_offset upper_offset
param.help: The first line is a header and will be skipped select txt data sets(s)

param.label: If set, do not remove cached files created in tempDirectory

param.name: evidence_sources
param.label: Evidence source used to keep precursor candidates: 'ms1', 'ms2', or 'hybrid' (MS1 OR MS2)

param.name: ms1_top_peaks_per_spectrum
param.label: Number of most intense MS1 peaks to keep per spectrum before precursor m/z matching

param.name: ms2_top_peaks_per_spectrum
param.label: Number of most intense MS2 peaks to keep per spectrum before fragment m/z matching

param.name: ms2_top_transitions_per_precursor
param.label: Number of highest library-intensity fragment transitions to index per precursor for MS2 evidence

param.name: ms2_min_fragment_hits
param.label: Minimum number of distinct indexed fragments that must match in one MS2 spectrum to support a precurso

param.name: min_supported_precursors
param.label: Minimum number of supported precursors required when the prefilter is enabled

param.name: enabled
param.label: Run PeakPickerHiRes on spectra before top-N matching
param.help: This is intended for profile data and is disabled by default

param.name: use_gauss
param.label: Use Gaussian smoothing before PeakPickerHiRes
param.help: If false, use Savitzky-Golay smoothing

param.name: signal_to_noise
param.label: Minimal signal-to-noise ratio for a peak to be picked (0.0 disables SNT estimation!)

param.name: spacing_difference_gap
param.label: The extension of a peak is stopped if the spacing between two subsequent data points exceeds 'spacing_difference_gap * min_spacing'
param.help: 'min_spacing' is the smaller of the two spacings from the peak apex to its two neighboring points. '0' to disable the constraint. Not applicable to chromatograms

param.name: spacing_difference
param.label: Maximum allowed difference between points during peak extension, in multiples of the minimal difference between the peak apex and its two neighboring points
param.help: If this difference is exceeded a missing point is assumed (see parameter 'missing'). A higher value implies a less stringent peak definition, since individual signals within the peak are allowed to be further apart. '0' to disable the constraint. Not applicable to chromatograms

param.name: missing
param.label: Maximum number of missing points allowed when extending a peak to the left or to the right
param.help: A missing data point occurs if the spacing between two subsequent data points exceeds 'spacing_difference * min_spacing'. 'min_spacing' is the smaller of the two spacings from the peak apex to its two neighboring points. Not applicable to chromatograms

param.name: ms_levels
param.label: List of MS levels for which the peak picking is applied
param.help: If empty, auto mode is enabled, all peaks which aren't picked yet will get picked. Other scans are copied to the output without changes (space separated list, in order to allow for spaces in list items surround them by single quotes)

expand.name: ms_levels

validator.message: a space separated list of integer values in the range 1: is required

expand.validator: len(value.split(' ')) == len([_ for _ in value.split(' ') if 1 <= int(_)])

param.name: report_FWHM
param.label: Add metadata for FWHM (as floatDataArray named 'FWHM' or 'FWHM_ppm', depending on param 'report_FWHM_unit') for each picked peak

param.name: report_FWHM_unit
param.label: Unit of FWHM
param.help: Either absolute in the unit of input, e.g. 'm/z' for spectra, or relative as ppm (only sensible for spectra, not chromatograms)

param.name: allow_missing_flank
param.label: Allow peaks without flanking data points on both sides
param.help: This is useful for TimsTOF data where profile peaks may be missing the leading or trailing edge

param.name: max_intensity
param.label: maximal intensity considered for histogram construction
param.help: By default, it will be calculated automatically (see auto_mode). Only provide this parameter if you know what you are doing (and change 'auto_mode' to '-1')! All intensities EQUAL/ABOVE 'max_intensity' will be added to the LAST histogram bin. If you choose 'max_intensity' too small, the noise estimate might be too small as well. If chosen too big, the bins become quite large (which you could counter by increasing 'bin_count', which increases runtime). In general, the Median-S/N estimator is more robust to a manual max_intensity than the MeanIterative-S/N

param.name: auto_max_stdev_factor
param.label: parameter for 'max_intensity' estimation (if 'auto_mode' == 0): mean + 'auto_max_stdev_factor' * stdev

param.name: auto_max_percentile
param.label: parameter for 'max_intensity' estimation (if 'auto_mode' == 1): auto_max_percentile th percentile

param.name: auto_mode
param.label: method to use to determine maximal intensity: -1 --> use 'max_intensity'; 0 --> 'auto_max_stdev_factor' method (default); 1 --> 'auto_max_percentile' method

param.name: win_len
param.label: window length in Thomson

param.name: bin_count
param.label: number of bins for intensity values

param.name: min_required_elements
param.label: minimum number of elements required in a window (otherwise it is considered sparse)

param.name: noise_for_empty_window
param.label: noise value used for sparse windows

param.name: write_log_messages
param.label: Write out log messages in case of sparse windows or median in rightmost histogram bin

param.name: retentionTimeInterpretation
param.label: How to interpret the provided retention time (the retention time column can either be interpreted to be in iRT, minutes or seconds)

param.name: override_group_label_check
param.label: Override an internal check that assures that all members of the same PeptideGroupLabel have the same PeptideSequence (this ensures that only different isotopic forms of the same peptide can be grouped together in the same label group)
param.help: Only turn this off if you know what you are doing

param.name: force_invalid_mods
param.label: Force reading even if invalid modifications are encountered (OpenMS may not recognize the modification)
How to combine evidence across multiple input runs
param.help: 'any' keeps a target if it is supported in at least one run; 'all' requires support in every run

param.label: How to handle decoys in the output
param.help: 'remove' writes target-only output. 'keep_all' keeps all original decoys. 'keep_matching' keeps decoys whose peptide_ref maps to a kept target after removing decoy_prefix

param.label: Prefix used by decoy_handling=keep_matching to map decoy peptide_ref values back to target peptide_ref values
Minimal distance to the upper edge of a SWATH window to still consider a precursor, in Thomson
Data is targeted DIA / PRM-like data with potentially overlapping DIA windows
Overrides tool-specific checks
Sort input SWATH files when matching to SWATH windows from swath_windows_file
Treat all input files as one split SWATH run, with each file containing one SWATH window
Whether to run directly on input data or cache data to disk first
param.help: If 'cache', set tempDirectory as needed

param.label: How many threads the evidence filter should use (-1 uses the OpenMP maximum)
MS1 precursor m/z extraction window full width, in Thomson or ppm
Unit of mz_extraction_window_ms1
MS1 ion mobility extraction window full width
param.help: -1 disables MS1 IM filtering

param.label: MS2 fragment m/z extraction window full width, in Thomson or ppm
Unit of mz_extraction_window_ms2
MS2 ion mobility extraction window full width
param.help: -1 disables MS2 IM filtering

param.label: Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Filter transition-list precursors by quick raw-data evidence.
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_TransitionListEvidenceFilter.html
